status_detail: Expanded second-pass review published 35 new SHA-256 file indicators from the current MalwareBazaar browse records dated 2026-09-29. Accepted families were Mirai, ValleyRAT, VShell, AgentTesla, FormBook, PureLogsStealer, SnakeKeylogger, KONNI, and XWorm/SalatStealer; each record supplied an exact SHA-256 plus a named MalwareBazaar family signature and malware tags. Daily-Threat-Intel supplied only five IPv4 ThreatFox indicators and was correctly excluded from this hash-only feed. Bare hashes from the public MalwareBazaar export, unsigned/unknown records, and non-file indicators were rejected.
